name: the-downloader
title: The Downloader
description: Download videos, audio, image galleries, Spotify music, and complete webpages from YouTube, Reddit, Spotify and more
author: Stheno

commands.name: index
commands.title: Download
commands.subtitle: The Downloader
commands.description: Download video, audio, galleries, webpages, or transcripts

commands.name: fast-download
commands.title: Fast Download
commands.subtitle: The Downloader
commands.description: Paste a URL and download it instantly using your saved defaults — no form.

commands.name: history
commands.title: Download History
commands.subtitle: The Downloader
commands.description: Browse, open and re-download everything you've downloaded with The Downloader.

commands.name: chat-video
commands.title: Chat About Video
commands.subtitle: The Downloader
commands.description: Paste a video link and ask anything about it. Loads the transcript, details and statistics, and answers with Raycast AI, Apple Intelligence or Ollama.

tools.name: download-video
tools.title: Download Video
tools.description: Downloads a video from a given URL

tools.name: extract-transcript
tools.title: Extract Video Transcript
tools.description: Gets a video's details and its transcript with [m:ss] timestamps, for summarizing or answering questions about what is said

tools.name: get-video-info
tools.title: Get Video Info
tools.description: Gets a video's details and statistics without downloading it: title, channel, duration, views, likes, comments, engagement rates, chapters, tags, description and caption languages

preferences.name: downloadPath
preferences.title: Download Folder
preferences.description: Path to download video

preferences.name: videoMediaType
preferences.title: Video: Media Type
preferences.description: Default for video URLs: download the full video, or extract audio only.

preferences.name: videoQuality
preferences.title: Video: Quality
preferences.description: Default video resolution. Ignored when Media Type is Audio Only.

preferences.name: videoContainer
preferences.title: Video: Container
preferences.description: Default container for downloaded video. Ignored when Media Type is Audio Only.

preferences.name: audioFormat
preferences.title: Video: Audio Format
preferences.description: Default audio format when Media Type is Audio Only.

preferences.name: exactFormatSelection
preferences.title: Video: Exact Format Selection
preferences.description: Show an Exact Format field in the Download form for video downloads — every concrete yt-dlp format with its file size. Leave off for simple Quality + Container choices.
preferences.label: Enable

preferences.name: spotifyAudioFormat
preferences.title: Spotify: Audio Format
preferences.description: Default audio format for Spotify downloads.

preferences.name: webpageSaveMode
preferences.title: Webpage: Save Mode
preferences.description: Default for saved webpages. Complete embeds everything; Lightweight strips JavaScript.

preferences.name: autoLoadUrlFromClipboard
preferences.title: Auto Load URL from Clipboard
preferences.description: Automatically load the URL from the clipboard when the command is executed
preferences.label: Enable

preferences.name: autoLoadUrlFromSelectedText
preferences.title: Auto Load URL from Selected Text
preferences.description: Automatically load the URL from the selected text when the command is executed
preferences.label: Enable

preferences.name: enableBrowserExtensionSupport
preferences.title: Enable Browser Extension Support
preferences.description: Enable browser extension support for reading video URLs from the browser
preferences.label: Enable

preferences.name: checkToolUpdates
preferences.title: Check for Tool Updates
preferences.description: Before a download, check whether the tools it uses (yt-dlp, gallery-dl, ffmpeg…) are outdated and offer to update them.
preferences.label: Enable

preferences.name: cookiesFromBrowser
preferences.title: Gallery: Cookies from Browser
preferences.description: Browser to read cookies from for login-gated galleries.

preferences.name: cookiesFromBrowserCustom
preferences.title: Gallery: Custom Browser Spec
preferences.description: Used when 'Cookies from Browser' is set to Custom. Pass a gallery-dl --cookies-from-browser spec, e.g. `firefox:/path/to/profile` or `chromium:C:\Users\…\User Data\Default`.

preferences.name: spotifyClientId
preferences.title: Spotify: Client ID
preferences.description: Spotify Developer app Client ID. Required for reliable Spotify downloads — without it, spotDL's anonymous session frequently fails with 'Could not get session auth tokens'. See SPOTIFY.md for one-time setup.

preferences.name: spotifyClientSecret
preferences.title: Spotify: Client Secret
preferences.description: Spotify Developer app Client Secret. Pairs with Client ID above. Stored as a password.

preferences.name: spotifyUserAuth
preferences.title: Spotify: User Authentication
preferences.description: Enable browser-based OAuth so spotDL can read your private playlists and saved library. On the next Spotify download your browser opens once to authorize the Dev app on http://127.0.0.1:9900/, which must be registered as a Redirect URI on the app. See SPOTIFY.md.
preferences.label: Use browser OAuth for private content

preferences.name: homebrewPath
preferences.title: Homebrew Path
preferences.description: macOS only — ignored on Windows. Path to the Homebrew executable. Run `which brew` in Terminal to find it.

preferences.name: ytdlPath
preferences.title: yt-dlp Path
preferences.description: Path to the yt-dlp executable. You can enter `which yt-dlp` to terminal to find its path.

preferences.name: ffmpegPath
preferences.title: FFmpeg Path
preferences.description: Path to the ffmpeg executable. You can enter `which ffmpeg` to terminal to find its path.

preferences.name: ffprobePath
preferences.title: FFprobe Path
preferences.description: Path to the ffprobe executable. Usually installed along with ffmpeg. You can enter `which ffprobe` to terminal to find its path.

preferences.name: denoPath
preferences.title: Deno Path
preferences.description: Path to the Deno executable — the JavaScript runtime yt-dlp uses for YouTube. Run `which deno` to find it.

preferences.name: galleryDlPath
preferences.title: gallery-dl Path
preferences.description: Path to the gallery-dl executable. Run `which gallery-dl` to find it.

preferences.name: spotDlPath
preferences.title: spotDL Path
preferences.description: Path to the spotDL executable. Leave blank to use the copy this extension downloads automatically.

preferences.name: monolithPath
preferences.title: Monolith Path
preferences.description: Path to the monolith executable. Run `which monolith` to find it.

preferences.name: forceIpv4
preferences.title: Force IPv4 (Experimental)
preferences.description: Force IPv4 for network requests, this can be useful if you have some network issues. But this should be a temporary solution. We might remove this option in the future.
preferences.label: Enable

preferences.name: aiEngine
preferences.title: Chat: AI Engine
preferences.description: Which model answers in Chat About Video. Automatic uses Raycast AI when you have access, then Apple Intelligence on macOS 27, then a running Ollama.

preferences.name: raycastModel
preferences.title: Chat: Raycast AI Model
preferences.description: Model for Raycast AI answers. Default follows Raycast's own choice.

preferences.name: ollamaUrl
preferences.title: Chat: Ollama URL
preferences.description: Address of your Ollama server.

preferences.name: ollamaModel
preferences.title: Chat: Ollama Model
preferences.description: Model name, e.g. `llama3.2` or `qwen3:8b`. Leave blank to use the first installed model.

preferences.name: ollamaContext
preferences.title: Chat: Ollama Context Size
preferences.description: Context window (num_ctx) in tokens. Larger fits more of the transcript but needs more memory. Integer; default 8192.

preferences.name: transcriptLanguage
preferences.title: Chat: Transcript Language
preferences.description: Caption language to load, as a code like `en` or `de`. Auto uses the video's own language, then English.

preferences.name: networkIdleTimeoutSec
preferences.title: Network: Idle Timeout
preferences.description: Seconds of silence from a download before the extension assumes it is wedged and kills the child process. Real downloads emit progress every second, so 120 is plenty for fast networks; raise it on very slow links. Integer; default 120.

ai.instructions: After downloading the video, always link the video with [<video title>](<download path>), so the user can easily open it. When answering from a transcript, point to moments with their timestamp as a link, like [4:05](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ID&t=245s), using the link format the tool output shows, and only state what the transcript and video details support. Reply in the user's language.
